title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 71
description: Ten questions on Psalms 71: a prayer from youth to old age, trust in God as rock and fortress, and praise with harp and lyre.

questions.text: In verse 3, the speaker calls God his rock and his what?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "For you are my rock and my fortress."

questions.text: From when has the speaker relied on God, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "I have relied on you from the womb."

questions.text: What does the speaker say he is to many?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge."

questions.text: When does the speaker ask God not to reject him?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "Don't reject me in my old age. Don't forsake me when my strength fails."

answers.text: In the middle of the night

questions.text: According to his enemies, what has God done to the speaker?
questions.explanation: In verses 10-11 his enemies say, "God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him."

questions.text: To whom does the speaker want to declare God's strength?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 asks God not to forsake him until he has declared God's strength to the next generation.

questions.text: According to verse 19, how far does God's righteousness reach?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says: "Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens."

answers.text: To the ends of the sea
To the gates of the city
To the roots of the mountains

questions.text: From where does the speaker say God will bring them up again?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says: "You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth."

answers.text: From the depths of the earth
From the pit of the lions
From the bottom of the sea

questions.text: With which instruments does the speaker praise God in verse 22?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says he will praise God with the harp and sing praises with the lyre.

questions.text: What does the speaker say God has done to his soul?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says: "My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!"
